sources.snippet: g4me/CutIA-Qwen-4B-fromInstruct-TF is a 4 billion parameter causal language model, fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. This experimental checkpoint is designed for general instruction-following tasks, leveraging the Qwen3 architecture. It offers a 32768 token context length, making it suitable for applications requiring processing of moderately long inputs.
